liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Rollin' & Tumblin'** (2 other sources): Notes mark this as the first time the band played it [1][6]
- **Touch Of Grey** (1 review): Someone flew over the stage during this song, with perfect timing [16]
- **Ramble On Rose** (1 review): Reviewer found this one not too bad, among a few musical bright spots [18]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): Reviewer singles this out as one of the good performances of the night [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1995-06-15.135288.aud.fob.lamarre-berger.flac1648** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 156 min [1]
- **gd95-06-15.schoeps.7745.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 20 songs; 163 min; rated 2.77/5 by 60 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the audience recording's sound quality pretty sweet; Reviewer says the sound is great for an audience-mic recording [15][19]
- **gd1995-06-15.145838.sony.ecm909a.sterry.beckwith.miller.sirmick.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 157 min [5]. Said about its sound: A left channel dropout was fixed by copying the right channel, leaving this song mono; First two Set II tracks may come from another source; static noises were removed and the Set II levels corrected [5]
- **gd1995-06-15.143132.SonyECM-909A.sterry.beckwith.sirmick.miller.flac2496**: source not stated; 20 songs; 157 min [6]. Said about its sound: A left channel dropout was fixed by copying the right channel, leaving this song mono [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer lived near the venue, so it was a hometown show; they hung a sign inviting friends to camp [10]
- Reviewer says Garcia missed lyrics even with a teleprompter in use [12]
- Camping and partying around the show were enjoyable, according to the reviewer [12]
- Reviewer drove nonstop from St. George, Utah, partied all night and got in free [13]
- Residents of the small, hot Vermont town were kind, and the reviewer paid for a ticket rather than crashing the gate [15]
- Reviewer walked about three miles to the stage, which was extremely crowded and claustrophobic [16]
- Reviewer says Garcia stumbled through the whole show, so it felt like the end for him [17]
- Dylan's opening set was pretty good, and bands played from trucks in the parking lot [17]
- Reviewer felt the band was nearing the end, calling this the start of a cursed summer tour [16]
- Reviewer rates it as not awesome, but better than many other 1995 shows [19]
- Oxford Plains shows in '88 were never repeated at that site, so the band moved to Highgate for summer northeast dates [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1995-06-15.135288.aud.fob.lamarre-berger.flac1648**: taped by Doug Lamarre; transferred by Rob Berger; source: flac16/48kHz ; source: FOB daud master taped by Doug Lamarre; Sanken COS-11BP lavalier mics (Dan Liff’s r.i.p.) > Denon DTR-80P 30’ in front of soundboard;… [1]
- **gd95-06-15.schoeps.7745.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Matt Bertollo and Tim Wiley; source: Audience: Schoeps MK4V's [2]
- **gd1995-06-15.145838.sony.ecm909a.sterry.beckwith.miller.sirmick.flac16**: taped by George Sterry; transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick and David Beckwith; source: Source: Sony ECM-909A > Sony WM-D3 > Cassette Master (Maxell XL-II90) - Recorded by George Sterry * [5]
- **gd1995-06-15.143132.SonyECM-909A.sterry.beckwith.sirmick.miller.flac2496**: taped by George Sterry; transferred by Charlie Miller and SIRMick and David Beckwith; source: Sony ECM-909A > Sony WM-D3 > Cassette Master (Maxell XL-II90) - Recorded by George Sterry [6]
